name: search_knowledge_base
description: Search the local knowledge base. by=content (default) searches file contents; by=name finds files by name, directory, extension, or path fragment. Content search returns paths plus snippets. When snippets are not enough, read the file with read using its kb: path. Mention paths only when useful or asked.

query.description: Search terms, the user's question, or — with by=name — a file name, directory, extension, or path fragment.

by.description: content searches contents, name searches paths. Defaults to content.

max_results.description: Optional limit on the number of results.
